name: new-tab-from-selection
title: New Tab from Selection
description: Open the selected text (or clipboard) in a new browser tab — a URL opens directly, anything else is searched with your chosen engine.
author: tim_gailey

commands.name: new-tab-selection
commands.title: New Tab from Selection
commands.description: Open the selected text in a new browser tab — opens a URL directly, or searches it otherwise.

commands.name: new-tab-clipboard
commands.title: New Tab from Clipboard
commands.description: Open the clipboard text in a new browser tab — opens a URL directly, or searches it otherwise.

commands.name: new-tab-selection-text
commands.title: New Tab from Selection + Text
commands.description: Open the selected text plus any extra terms you type in a new browser tab (Tab into the box to add them).

preferences.name: engine
preferences.title: Search Engine
preferences.description: Engine used when the text is a search query. Choose Custom to use your own template below.

preferences.name: customSearchUrl
preferences.title: Custom Search Template
preferences.description: URL template used when Engine = Custom. Must contain {query}. Falls back to DuckDuckGo if blank or missing {query}.

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Browser
preferences.description: Browser to open results in. Default = system default browser.

preferences.name: openUrlsDirectly
preferences.title: URL Handling
preferences.label: Open the text directly when it is a URL (instead of searching for it)
preferences.description: When on, a selection like github.com/x opens that page. When off, every selection is searched.
